figures.caption: Fig. 1. System architecture of SemProbe. The pipeline combines image input, manual/automatic masking, ODD-driven prompt construction, ComfyUI-based inpainting, automatic YOLO post-analysis, and structured logging.
Fig. 2. SemProbe interface: the user uploads an image, masks the hand region, selects a factor from the ODD-derived catalog, triggers inpainting, and receives a side-by-side detection comparison.
